description: Defines the Drupal contact message entity class, including its properties, methods, and entity type annotations.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents a contact message entity in Drupal, with methods for accessing and setting message properties, and defining base fields.

methods.name: isPersonal
methods.description: Checks if the message is marked as personal based on its bundle.

methods.name: getContactForm
methods.description: Retrieves the associated contact form entity.

methods.name: copySender
methods.description: Indicates whether a copy should be sent to the sender.

methods.name: setCopySender
methods.description: Sets whether to send a copy to the sender.

methods.name: getPersonalRecipient
methods.description: Returns the recipient entity if the message is personal.

methods.name: baseFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Defines the base fields for the contact message entity, including form ID, UUID, language code, sender info, subject, message, copy option, and recipient.
